regions.notes: river_outline is the river's water between the top-lane and bottom-lane crossings, traced from assets/maps/Game_map_7.41.jpg (water colour mask, both Roshan pools included) and projected to world units through the gem.reports._formatting window; scripts/trace_river_region.py regenerates it and half_line. half_line runs along the river's middle and, past its ends, flat to beyond the map edges; points below it (towards the Radiant fountain) are radiant_half. lotus_pools are the lotus pool entity positions from replay 8974053011; a point within lotus_radius of one is that lotus area, which belongs to neither half. Region precedence: lotus, river, then the halves.

notes: Analysis constants: world_bounds are the playable map's world-unit extent. fountains are the ent_dota_fountain_good / ent_dota_fountain_bad entity positions (CDOTA_Unit_Fountain), identical on every local fixture replay; region_of falls back to their perpendicular bisector when the region geometry is unavailable. regions drive gem.analysis region_of. HTML reports do not use these to place points on assets/maps/Game_map_7.41.jpg; gem.reports._formatting holds that calibrated window. World coords are Source 2 units.
